items.title: Three big takeaways from the IMF-World Bank meetings
items.summary: The world's finance chiefs spent last week in Bangkok debating the biggest risk facing the global economy — with debt, artificial intelligence and trade imbalances topping the list.

items.title: Anthropic is AI trade's last big hope for a major IPO this year
items.summary: Heading into 2026, investors were excited at the prospect of a host of new initial public offerings , including ones from mega-cap private companies like SpaceX , Anthropic and OpenAI .

items.title: Robot factories and hypersonic missiles: JPMorgan Chase's first $5 billion of defense investments
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase has made $5 billion in startup investments in the first year of its U.S. security and resiliency initiative , the company said Monday, a faster-than-expected pace that indicates the bank is finding plentiful opportunities in emerging defense, manufacturing and supply chain firms.

items.title: Women may be at greater risk of AI job losses. Telephone switch operators and PCs show why
items.summary: Decades before Siri or Alexa or ChatGPT, there was a real person, almost always a woman, at the center of the information world.

items.title: India’s finance minister says market liquidity makes it easier for investors to exit
items.summary: The high degree of liquidity in India's equity market has provided easier exits to foreign portfolio investors, according to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman.
